subject: Re: IMP kickoff - staffing + Vulcan booking for the MoE-L run
body:
Anders,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Csilla 60%, Tereza 40%, Vera 50%, Jorge 60% through July 20.
- Base repros (IMP-B, IMP-MoE-B): 64 titan-a100 best-effort covers it. Jorge has the released config stack (imp_base.all.train / sparse_moe_imp_base.all.train) running already.
- The big one, booked as you asked: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation - 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-07-06 - for the IMP-MoE-L-scale training run. Went through the Infra Lead reservation process and it's confirmed on my side; that placement gives us buffer after the run for the July 20 memo, and it's comfortably clear of the Vulcan maintenance window in late June.

Risk to note: MoE-L at 350M params is at the edge of what one week at 128 H100s buys us, so Csilla is preparing a reduced-token-budget variant as the fallback if throughput disappoints mid-week.

Bruno
